reviewText: The Toor Dal is genuinely unpolished and cooks into the most aromatic, authentic sambar. The 1kg pack is clean, well-sealed, and delivered promptly via WhatsApp.
Very impressed with the Cashew Nuts (முந்திரி பருப்பு) and Almonds. Crisp, fresh, and large-sized without any breakage. Placing the order on WhatsApp took less than a minute.
Ordered Idli Rice and cold-pressed Sesame Oil. The idlis turned out soft and fluffy. Having five pack sizes (100g to 1kg) is very practical for our joint family pantry.
The Toor Dal is genuinely unpolished — the sambar turns out so much more aromatic than anything from a supermarket. Bensi Queen is now my permanent go-to store.
Ordered Cashew Nuts and California Almonds. They arrived the same evening, perfectly packed, super fresh. The WhatsApp ordering made everything so simple.
The Sambar Powder smells exactly like home-ground masala. No artificial color, genuine flavor. I have been ordering monthly supplies for over a year now.
